Description
KPU is Canada's only polytechnic university. We focus on hands-on skills, in addition to traditional academics. Your education will go beyond books, with experiential learning opportunities like group projects, presentations, guest speakers, and more. Many of our programs include work experience terms, practicums, or cooperative education options. International learning opportunities all over the world through field schools, exchanges, study abroad opportunities, and more.
